WHY SHIVA EXIM

What Gulf buyers get from us.

From the cumin and fennel belt

We are in Mehsana, North Gujarat, near the Unjha market for cumin and fennel.

99% Europe & Singapore quality

Cumin and fennel in the trade grades Gulf buyers ask for. The specification is confirmed for each lot.

Free samples

The sample is free. You pay only the courier charge.

From 1 MT

Minimum order 1 metric tonne. Full 20-ft and 40-ft containers for larger orders.

Registered exporter

APEDA, Spices Board India, FSSAI and IOPEPC. In business since 2018.

Simple payment

T/T, L/C or PayPal, agreed in the quotation.

Buying for Kuwait or Bahrain? We welcome your enquiry too. Tell us your port and requirement.
